name: Mumossum
look: a mother opossum with huge dark ears, a black frilly collar and a pink-hearted belly, smiling, carrying six of her babies on her head, back and tail
entry: It carries a half dozen of its babies wherever it goes. When something threatens them it plucks the bravest ones off its back and slings them at the enemy with its tail; they come straight back to it, very pleased with themselves.
how: Evolve Obubby at level 30. It learns Joey Slingshot when it evolves.
Wild: uncommon in forests and plains at night.
